scope: 1218 class-identifier pairs for Fusion 2706.1.17. The static library extraction that first produced them was removed. Every identifier also appears in the runtime reflection capture re/Fusion/LocalOracle/Reflection/Versions.json.

runtimeSource.note: Loaded runtime metadata dump supplied by parent agent; includes current member names and versions, not member wire types.

fullStudyCorpusCoverage.scope: Every .f3d under re/Fusion/Study and every Design MetaStream member within those archives. No production decoder or test suite was executed. This counts captured class declarations and primary object ownership, not implemented codec coverage or vendor loadability.
fullStudyCorpusCoverage.method: Python standard-library ZIP central-directory inspection, local-header reads, deflate/store decoding or installed Homebrew libzstd through ctypes, exact uncompressed length and CRC verification, then raw version8 metadata grammar extraction. Class identifiers match case-insensitively while literal spellings remain recorded. Complete metadata tails and primary identity tables are checked structurally.
fullStudyCorpusCoverage.archiveManifestHashRule: SHA-256 of UTF-8 relative archive path, NUL, lowercase archive SHA-256, LF for each entry in sorted archives order
fullStudyCorpusCoverage.namingCoverageCaution: 100% name mapping does not imply typed field coverage, implemented reading/writing, lossless conversion, or vendor acceptance. The 712 captures include exactly one schema version per captured identifier.
